title: The productivity hack that Silicon Valley keeps secret

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: You ever wonder why top Silicon Valley CEOs work 20-hour days?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This hack is changing how tech giants manage their time — and it’s here for everyone.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s called "Time Blocking 2.0" — a hyper-specific scheduling method used by Apple and Google teams.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key? Using AI to auto-prioritize tasks based on your energy levels and deadlines.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s boosting productivity by 40% in early adopter companies like Tesla and Meta.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The takeaway? Your time is your most valuable asset — treat it like code.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to learn how to implement this in your own life? Drop a comment below.
